trades.description: An Art Operations Associate helps organize the daily work behind creating, moving, and showing artwork. They track pieces, update records, pack and ship art, set up displays, coordinate schedules, and help keep studios, galleries, or storage areas in order. Their work keeps artwork protected, events running smoothly, and collections easy to find and manage.
